lines.text: Okay. Pie shop job. Holiday rush. Let's begin.
And Angel, what do you do?
My best.
No. Like, what are your skills?
My best.
That is the same answer. You cannot use the same answer twice.
Watch me. It is my best answer.
Hello. I am the pumpkin. I sit on the desk. I see every interview.
This is the best one so far.
Nobody asked the pumpkin.
Can you roll out a crust?
I can try my best.
Have you ever rolled out a crust?
I have rolled out of bed.
That is basically the same move.
Next question. Where do you see yourself in five years?
Doing my best. But taller.
Do you have any experience with customers?
I have been a customer. Many times.
I bought a pie once. I ate it in the car.
The whole pie?
I did my best.
She is a natural.
Okay. Biggest weakness. Go.
Whipped cream.
That is not a weakness. That is a topping.
Not the way I do it.
Thursday after next, we sell four hundred pies. Four hundred.
Please do not say the number. I get nervous.
The line goes out the door, around the parking lot and into the car wash.
A lady screams about crust. A man cries about cranberries.
So I ask you again. Angel. What do you do?
My best.
Chills. I have chills. Pumpkins do not get chills.
Every person today said they were a perfectionist.
And?
They burned the pies. Perfectly. In a perfect little line.
The smoke alarm also did its best. It was very loud about it.
So, do I get the job?
That is not up to me.
You are the one asking the questions.
I am also here for the interview. They told me to sit on this side.
Then who owns the pie shop?
I do.
The pumpkin?
I bought the shop in nineteen ninety nine. Nobody suspects a pumpkin.
Every November, someone looks at me and says pie. So I bought the place.
That is a power move.
Now. Mister Delgado. My turn.
And Mister Delgado, what do you do?
I have twenty years of experience. I manage, I bake, I
Psst. Say it.
My best.
You are both hired.
What is my job title?
Crust roller. You have already rolled out of bed. It is the same move.
And me?
You keep asking questions. Customers love that.
Thank you, sir. Ma'am. Pumpkin.
One more question. What do we bake first?
Anything. Anything at all. Just not pumpkin.
We are a pie shop in November.
And I am doing my best.
